attr.title: Terraria
attr.desc: Terraria Android 1.4.5.6.4 through a native AArch64 Unity/IL2CPP compatibility loader. One low-glibc loader negotiates the firmware SDL backend at runtime, supports native controllers, sound, persistent saves and lifecycle-aware exit. BYO-data; game files are not included.
attr.inst: Place your legal Terraria Android 1.4.5.6.4 APK in terraria/gamedata and launch the port. NXExtract 1.2.0 validates and prepares the arm64 data automatically.
